authority_note: Interfaces define exchange capability only; authority per charter authority-matrix. No adapter holds approval or unrestricted publication authority.
counterparty_authority: bekindrewind_runtime (pattern generalizes to future runtime targets)
exchange_model: immutable compiled packages out; acceptance/rejection receipts and aggregate observations in; runtime operable without live Storyworld connection

operations.validation: dangling refs, impossible/circular missions, inaccessible content, missing media/localization, conflicting transitions, rights expiry, runtime budgets, canon drift

operations.effect: approval receipt (publication_or_runtime_acceptance, authority_host bekindrewind_runtime); lifecycle runtime_released

operations.rule: aggregate only; player identities and player state never enter Storyworld
emergency runtime changes reconcile through a later explicit import; compiled files never silently become canon
